verdict.rationale: The only mention of extension is an FAQ heading phrased as a question ("Can I extend a prior video?"), which is not an affirmative claim that the capability exists. Modify Video V2 restyles existing footage as a whole and Multi-Keyframe directs a single generation; neither is documented as extending a clip or regenerating one segment while leaving the rest of the video untouched. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
